source_evidence: When you withdraw your money or receive annuitized payments, you will pay tax on the gains at ordinary federal income tax rates rather than lower capital gains rates.
question: Since growth in a variable annuity is tax-deferred, are withdrawals of its gains tax-free?
answer: No. Tax-deferred growth means federal taxes are postponed, not eliminated. When you withdraw money or receive annuitized payments, gains are taxed at ordinary federal income tax rates rather than lower capital gains rates.
